verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The cache lifecycle is strongest: complete key composition, remote lookup, matching-result restore, isolated miss execution, success-gated immutable artifact upload, atomic publication, and contention convergence are all represented.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: Failure propagation to dependent tasks is absent; the board shows failure logs but does not show failed tasks blocking their dependents. Graph-level concurrent execution of unrelated branches is also absent.
verdict.coverage_summary: Weighted coverage is 40/47 = 0.8511. Most components and the end-to-end cache execution/publication flow are covered, but two system-defining operational semantics are absent: unrelated graph branches running concurrently and failed tasks blocking dependents. Log delivery and the precise provenance trust boundary are only partial. The raw coverage maps to 7, then the absent-system-defining cap reduces the final score to 6.
